notes.title: Some Sheepy Fixes. Game Patch Update (March 2025).
notes.content:
We've just updated the game with some fixes outlined below:

[b]First Boss Reset Bug[/b]
The first boss was not resetting correctly when you died 50% of the time, it is now fixed.

[b]Gamepad Fix Take 3[/b]
The code which detected the gamepad and switch between keyboard and gamepad is optimized now, so it has fixed a lot of different known bugs (gamepad not being detected, the skills tutorials showing the keyboard instead of the gamepad, even VHS acceleration effect had problems because of that and it should be working perfectly now)

[b]Gamepad Vibration Option[/b]
Vibrations options added, so you can simply go into the title screen options/pause options to change that when you want. 

[b]Fullscreen/Window Option[/b]
The fullscreen/windowed options randomly bugged for many people, it should be fixed & stable now.

[b]Cutscene Skip[/b]
You can now skip cutscenes directly, no need anymore to watch it once. This applies to any cinematics in the game now.

[b]Dpad Controls[/b]
You can now play the whole game with the dpad should you so desire. #streetfighterfingers

[b]Multiple Skill Inputs[/b]
Each skill action now has multiple inputs (for example you can use B to jump, L1 to astral fly, etc). You even can use mouse for Ram Speed & Astral Projection now..

[b]Smaller Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Ram Speed running no longer has different speeds in function of if you was orienting the joystick in the direction or not touching it (now it simply keeps the same speed) 
[*] Sheepy no longer moves during the cinematic if you activate the Stone Monument directly from Ram Speed. As fun as that one was.
[/list]

There are several more minor fixes too. 

Optimization is up next. Then onto Steamdeck ;)

notes.title: State of Play: One Year On
notes.content:
Here we are, one year on from release. A huge thank you to all the players, its been quite the journey for us as a first time developer and we've learned a lot within this time. Below is a list of updates ranging from in-game to beyond. We're only just getting started with the world Sheepy. 

[h3]Next Game in Development[/h3]
We're very excited announce that our next game project is now officially in development. Bringing together the same team as before, we are in early pre-production and can't wait to bring you more when the time is right. 

[h3]Sheepy: The Plushie[/h3]
[url=https://sheepy.io]https://sheepy.io[/url]

We have created our first plushie for Sheepy that is now available to buy at [url=https://sheepy.io/]sheepy.io[/url] in limited quantities. We're very happy with how this turned out (after several iterations) and are hoping to create more poses this year :) For now you can order it directly through our dedicated Sheepy store. For the music lovers among you, we are in the middle of pressing a Sheepy: OST Vinyl run,  so stay tuned.

[h3]Sheepy: The Manga[/h3] (Patreon & Webtoons) 
[url=https://www.patreon.com/sheepymanga]https://www.patreon.com/sheepymanga[/url]

Writer/Producer Rob Thomas (Sheepy: A Short Adventure) and Manga Artist Omar Lozano (Dark Horse and Ravensburger (Lorcana) have been working on an original Manga series for Sheepy. The series follows his journey before, during and after the game in a new light. We will explore more of the lore and context behind the world Sheepy finds himself in that may ultimately provide more questions than answers...

We have set up a Patreon account for exclusive access to the original manga chapters as we complete them, for those inclined to support through a subscription. The manga series will eventually be free on Webtoons as well.

Chapter 0.1 is now available to experience for premium subscribers on Patreon. This is an amazing opportunity to dive deeper into world of Sheepy and we cant wait to develop this series further.

[h3]Nintendo: Switch Port
[/h3]
We have teamed up with Seaven Studio in Paris and they are working on porting Sheepy to Nintendo Switch. We're aiming for a Q2 release on the platform so will keep you informed as and when! 

[h3]Steam & Steamdeck Optimization[/h3]
Once the game has been optimized for Switch, we'll take the tech lessons from the port and apply them to our PC version/s and our ultimate goal of gaining an official Steamdeck compatible release in due course.

[h3]Languages & Localisation[/h3]
We are in the process of developing a language framework for the written text in the game. For the moment we have limited translation to a handful of languages to test this out, and we will reach back out to those who have shown interest in localization when successful.

That's it for the time being. We're only just getting started :)

Best,


Rob, Thomas & The Sheepy Dev Crew  x . x

notes.title: Sheepy Updates (April 2024)
notes.content:
Sheepy Updates :)

[list]
[*] Sheepy - YouTube Channel
[*] Game News
[/list]

[h3]Sheepy - YouTube Channel [/h3]
[previewyoutube=PreZLSmewtY;full][/previewyoutube]
Sheepy now has a dedicated home on Youtube. We'll be posting there every so often, primarily in the form of music, ambience and most importantly: chair. The first video on channel is now live. 10 hours of chair. You're welcome.

[h3]Bugs & Optimisation[/h3]
As always, a big thank you to those recording bugs that are encountered via the bug report platform and by email. We will be back on the bug fixing train from May and hope have most of the main issues dealt with soon after - Optimization being the biggest hurdle to overcome.

[h3]Localisation[/h3]
Once the next phase of Bugs & Optimisation has been dealt with to a satisfactory level, we're looking forward to having the game localized into many different languages, once the time is right. I know a few people have reached out already for this - it is on our radar and will happen in due course.

[h3]Consoles[/h3]
Sheepy will be on consoles. Timing is TBA per platform, however we are actively working towards making this a reality.

[h3]Steamdeck[/h3]
That includes you Steamdeck, that includes you. 

Til next time. 

Chair (10 hrs)

notes.title: SHEEPY UPDATED (V1.2)
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Thomas Lean here!

Sheepy is updated again with a few other bugs fixed!


First of all, bosses are not bugging anymore if you hit them at a certain timing, it should work perfectly now and always resetting the boss correctly.

Next, a few minor things:
- You can't get stuck anymore into falling blocks when they respawn over you.
- The elevator sound loop is not playing infinitely anymore if you go away after activating an elevator.
- Falling instead of getting into the elevator at the end of the first boss purchase doesn't bug anymore.
- For the few who asked, you can now play with the directional pad :)

And last, we know that some other bugs are still here. The main one on which we want to focus right now is the gamepad not working for some of you. We've applied a few fixes already with 1.1 and it has worked for some of you, but it seems to still not work for some others.
We're still not sure why it's happening so if you want to help, feel free to let us know more about your setup (gamepad type, is it an official one or not? Are you using a software to remap it? etc). It may help us a lot to understand why it's still not working for you!


That's all for this one! We will still work on the remaining bugs during the next few weeks.


Thanks again a lot to everyone for playing Sheepy and thanks for all the good vibes <3

notes.title: One Patch to Rule Them All
notes.content:
Good morning/afternoon/evening!

Here are a list of fixes (and hopeful fixes) to some of the issues plaguing some players. A big thank you to  you for commenting and submitting bug reports - with your help, we'll polish this into a shiny optimized wooly gem.

Good news: all the main bugs which force players to quit and restart the game are now fixed! More details below.

GAMEPAD (pt 1)
For the players having the gamepad not working: we've tried to apply a few fixes already but we're still not sure what is exactly causing this problem. Feel free to tell us if it's fixed or not on your side now.

BOSS BUGS
We still have to fix the bug causing the bosses to bug sometimes when you die at a "wrong" timing. It may take more time but we're on it during next days. Again, thanks a lot for all your feedbacks, it helped us a lot to debug different things.

MAIN BUG FIXES
GAMEPAD (pt 2) 
We've tried to apply a few fixes for the not working gamepad issue. Still we're not sure that it'll work for everyone since it could be caused by a lot of things external to the game (Steam options, type of gamepad, how your computer manage it, etc). Let us know if it worked or not for you! It'll help us a lot if we need to find other fixes.

TO INFINITY SHEEP AND BEYOND
You can't infinity fly anymore. Thanks a lot to the players which have found how to trigger this bug, it helps us to understand a bug that we were trying to figure out since many months!

CAMERA UNZOOM
The camera doesn't bug anymore, so no big unzooming anymore.

LEVER JUMPING
You can't jump with a lever when you activate it anymore, I agree it was a fun bug but hey, it's our job to hunt them.

STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS
You can't restart the game and unlock the Speedrun achievements. Now the only way to get them is to do the official ways. Same for the No Death one, no "cheating" this possible anymore.

FINAL CHAPTER
GOD SPEAKS ZOOMIES
Interacting with the magic stone (before entering the Temple) while running fast created bugs, it's fixed now. (Although that was hilarious).

FINAL ZOOMIES
The camera unzooming bug is fixed, so you won't have to close and restart the game anymore, everything should work fine now.

I LIKE ORANGES, AND I WONT MOVE.
The bug with Sheepy being stuck into the orange pillar's orb is fixed too.

INVISI-PATCHES
Patches doesn't magically go invisible anymore during the final fight, it should be fixed for Sheepy too.

MISC
Before, if you quited the game during the [spoiler]Paris cinematic[/spoiler] and restart the game and Continue, it spawned Sheepy at the beginning of the previous level, with the boss already defeated and the wrong killzones activated. It's fixed now, no need to restart your adventure from zero anymore :)

SHEEP VIBRATIONS
Gamepad should not infinitly vibrate anymore when you arrive at the Credits part.

LOADING SCREEN CAMERA SHAKE
Camera was sometimes still shaking during the Loading screen, it's fixed now.

CREDITS
Credits updated, and ye I know it's "developed" and not "developped", french mistake. 

Thanks. We'll keep at it. 

Rob & Thomas.
